**[Recall Knowledge - Humanoid](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=14)): DC 41 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 39 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 36 [Xiuli Cachu](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2564) **Source** [Pathfinder #191: The Destiny War](/Sources.aspx?ID=199) pg. 40 **Perception** +25; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Languages** [Abyssal](/Languages.aspx?ID=12), [Undercommon](/Languages.aspx?ID=11) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +24, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +23, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +27, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) +24, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) +25 **Str** +4 **Dex** +5 **Con** +5 **Int** +2 **Wis** +6 **Cha** +5 **Items** bone [symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=41) of [Lamashtu](/Deities.aspx?ID=11), _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [wounding](/Equipment.aspx?ID=309) [falchion](/Weapons.aspx?ID=18)_, [The Lost](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2509), [Material Component Pouch](/Equipment.aspx?ID=33), _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [studded leather armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=5)_ --- **AC** 34 **Fort** +24 **Ref** +22 **Will** +25 +2 status to all saves vs. [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) and [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) **HP** 235 **Resistances** [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) 13 --- **Speed** 30 feet, climb 20 feet **Melee** _falchion_ +24 ([Forceful](/Traits.aspx?ID=180), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [Sweep](/Traits.aspx?ID=194)), **Damage** 2d10+10 slashing **Melee** jaws +25 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)), **Damage** 3d4+10 piercing **Divine Innate Spells** DC 33 - **4th** [Confusion](/Spells.aspx?ID=48) **Divine Prepared Spells** DC 33, attack +25 - **Cantrips (7th)** [Bullhorn](/Spells.aspx?ID=877), [Chill Touch](/Spells.aspx?ID=35), [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Read Aura](/Spells.aspx?ID=246), [Shield](/Spells.aspx?ID=280) - **1st** [Bane](/Spells.aspx?ID=18), [Protection](/Spells.aspx?ID=238), [Sanctuary](/Spells.aspx?ID=266) - **2nd** [Darkness](/Spells.aspx?ID=59), [Death Knell](/Spells.aspx?ID=63), [See Invisibility](/Spells.aspx?ID=271) - **3rd** [Blindness](/Spells.aspx?ID=26), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Vampiric Touch](/Spells.aspx?ID=354) - **4th** [Air Walk](/Spells.aspx?ID=6), [Divine Wrath](/Spells.aspx?ID=86), [Outcast's Curse](/Spells.aspx?ID=211) - **5th** [Drop Dead](/Spells.aspx?ID=92), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Shadow Blast](/Spells.aspx?ID=273) - **6th** [Dispel Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=78), [Heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), [Repulsion](/Spells.aspx?ID=254) - **7th** [Divine Vessel](/Spells.aspx?ID=85), [Harm](/Spells.aspx?ID=146) (×4), [Regenerate](/Spells.aspx?ID=248) **Cleric Domain Spells** DC 33, 2 Focus Points - **7th** [Shared Nightmare](/Spells.aspx?ID=451), [Waking Nightmare](/Spells.aspx?ID=468) **Instinctual Tinker** The morlock tinkers with an adjacent [construct](/Traits.aspx?ID=35) or [mechanical](/Traits.aspx?ID=105) hazard. They attempt a [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) check against the construct's or hazard's Fortitude DC. The morlock can't succeed if the target's level is more than double the morlock's.
**Critical Success** The target gains 4d6 HP and a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls for 1 minute.
**Success** The target gains 2d6 HP.
**Critical Failure** The morlock injures itself, taking 2d6 damage (typically bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing, but potentially a different type at the GM's discretion). **Frenetic Casting** Xiuli Strides up to her speed. At any point during her movement, Xiuli can Cast a Spell that normally takes two actions or fewer to cast. **[Sneak Attack](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=34)** Xiuli deals an additional 3d6 precision damage to [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) creatures. **Swarming Stance** A morlock can share the same space as another morlock, but no more than two morlocks can occupy the same space. When morlocks share the same space, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls.
name: Xiuli Cachu
